pictures.name: low_doorstep
pictures.scene: a single worn stone doorstep at the foot of a plain wall, lit warm and low from one side so the hollow of long use shows, the wall above it rising blank and quiet into soft evening shadow

pictures.name: still_pool
pictures.scene: a small round pool of rainwater held in bare rock, its surface perfectly unbroken and lit warm along its near rim, the great dark of the sky lying across the whole of it without a ripple

pictures.name: high_peak_left_alone
pictures.scene: a very high snow peak standing far off and pale above a bank of cloud, the near hillside of low heather lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, everything between them soft and dim and blue

pictures.name: windless_evening
pictures.scene: a wide reed bed standing perfectly still on flat water at dusk, the nearest reeds lit warm along the bottom of the frame, the water and sky above them one unbroken depth of quiet blue

pictures.name: weaned_at_rest
pictures.scene: a mother sitting far off and small at the shaded edge of a courtyard with her child asleep against her, the paving near them lit low and warm, the middle of the court open and empty and dim
pictures.scene_no_people: a folded woollen shawl and a small empty cup set down together on a low bench at the shaded edge of a courtyard, lit low and warm, the middle of the court open and empty and dim

pictures.name: lamb_lying_down
pictures.scene: one young lamb lying asleep in deep grass beside a low stone wall, its fleece lit soft and warm at the bottom of the frame, the field above it rising quiet and dark toward a still evening sky

pictures.name: long_evening_light
pictures.scene: a wide open country of low hills under a long slow sunset, the nearest grass and stone lit deep gold along the bottom of the frame, the sky above it holding a vast and unhurried band of colour

pictures.name: first_stars
pictures.scene: a broad still land at the very end of dusk with the first stars showing, one last warm line of light along the low horizon, the whole sky above deepening into an immense and quiet dark

lines.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
My heart is not proud, O LORD,
I do not aspire to great things
or matters too lofty for me.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul;
like a weaned child with his mother,
like a weaned child is my soul within me.
O Israel, put your hope in the LORD,
